description: Confirm a signed custom-domain signup payment for a managed community. Before offering this action or requesting its inputs, check business permissions. FREE businesses cannot use this tool, regardless of individual feature rows. Call check_business_tool_access before collecting inputs. Show any grace-period warning and verified resubscribe link before continuing, and never proceed when access is blocked.

communityId.description: Nas.com business (community) ID. Use an ID returned by list_businesses or another Nas.com tool; never invent one.

signupToken.description: Signup token returned by the preceding step of this flow.
